description: Compute the per-tool SDK marker (KO-10) for a NOT-yet-created tool from its planned slug. Paid tools (price > 0) must embed this marker via the build env var CRELA_SDK_MARKER before building and submitting. For tools that already exist use get_sdk_marker (needs software_id, not slug). Returns { marker, slug, slug_available }. Requires CRELA_API_KEY.

slug.description: The planned URL slug of the tool you are about to submit

name: preview_marker
title: Preview the Crela SDK marker for a planned slug
